reviews.title: Insane set up time
reviews.comment: The amount of work that you have to do as an end user to set this up for any kind of local language model inference is insane. I mean, I knew it wasn’t gonna be Nvidia but holy cow dude I mean this is like hours worth of work to run a model and then find out that half the models don’t work like the price is great. Don’t get me wrong but you’re definitely earning those other $600 that you would’ve paid to Nvidia with elbow grease that you’re gonna have to spend on getting this thing running like you want it. If you buy this, just know. Even on windows the set up will be crazy. Linux as well.
reviews.author: Slows

reviews.title: Great Card for ComfyUI!
reviews.comment: I rarely (like almost never) write reviews, but this product is great! Perfect for ComfyUI and related workflows. This device may not be the fastest in the market (the performance is relative to like a RTX 3060), but the VRAM is the best selling point. It was able to work with ComfyUI on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS Server after the drivers and programs were installed. Perfect for high VRAM setups for under $1000.
reviews.author: Pixel
